content: reqwest 0.13 (from 0.12): default TLS backend flips from native-tls to rustls when no TLS feature is explicitly chosen; query()/form() become optional serde-gated features; RedirectPolicy moved to redirect::Policy; drops i686-pc-windows-gnu default support; ClientBuilder methods renamed (soft-deprecated).
